description: This is a test class for the PurgeDao, specifically testing employee data purge and extraction methods within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin.

classes.name: PurgeEmployeeDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the PurgeDao related to employee data management in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating a new PurgeDao instance, setting up the fixture path, and populating test data.

methods.name: testIsEmployeePurgeable
methods.description: Tests the eligibility of employee records for purging based on their IDs.

methods.name: testExtractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests extraction of employee data and related leave request comments from specified tables using employee numbers.
